posts.author: Awayamatana
posts.body:
It almost perfectly reproduces the transitions and encounter effects from previous rpg makers.
Can be used on map, in battle and in menu.
https://twitter.com/i/web/status/1869008898486862006
https://twitter.com/i/web/status/1832755824797884744
Download
Plugin
Transition200X.js
Ver.3.3.1
MIT License
This is a unique modification of Shioinu's
PD_Transition_MZ
to make it closer to the original.
Image
Reproduce "Inwards" and "Center Outwards" of RPG Maker 2000
How to Use
The following effects are available:
- Crossfade
- Gradient Wipe
- Scroll
- Split Screen
- Zoom
- Mosaic
- Raster Scroll
Put the gradient wipe image in the img/transitions folder.
In addition to RTPs from XP to VXAce, you can also get materials from the following site.
https://4you.bz

"Plugin Command" refers to the parameters used for the plugin commands "Hide Screen" and "Show Screen".
"Transfer Player" refers to the parameters used for the event command "Transfer Player".
Sorry, I don't have an English sample available,
only Japanese
.
And it's only the "Transfer Player".
